principle: People prefer designs that are as novel as they can be while still feeling familiar: typical enough to read, new enough to notice.
detect: A page that is either indistinguishable from every template or so unusual that its purpose is unclear.
fix: Keep a typical structure and introduce novelty in one element, such as the hero art or the type pairing.

source.title: "Most advanced, yet acceptable": Typicality and novelty as joint predictors of aesthetic preference in industrial design
source.author: Hekkert, Snelders & van Wieringen (2003)
